title: Git4Data: Database-Native Version Control for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.02106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly explore many candidate states of relational data in parallel, each of which should remain isolated, reproducible, and auditable, preferably through the same SQL interface used for ordinary data work. Existing tools support this requirement only partially: source-code version control does not scale to large datasets, whereas relational databases manage large data efficiently but rarely expose native branching, comparison, and merging. We present Git4Data, a database-native version-control layer for agentic workflows. Git4Data treats a database as a repository and a table as a versioned object, exposing Git-style operations (snapshot/tag, branch, diff, and merge with explicit conflict-resolution policies) through SQL extensions. Implemented in MatrixOne, a cloud-native relational database, Git4Data leverages immutable object storage and MVCC to make the cost of these operations proportional

translated_title: Git4Data：面向AI智能体的数据库原生版本控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.02106v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益并行地探索关系型数据的众多候选状态，每个状态都应保持隔离、可复现和可审计，且最好通过用于常规数据工作的同一SQL接口来实现。现有工具只能部分满足这一需求：源代码版本控制无法扩展至大型数据集，而关系型数据库虽能高效管理大规模数据，却很少提供原生的分支、比较与合并功能。我们提出了Git4Data，一个面向智能体工作流的数据库原生版本控制层。Git4Data将数据库视为仓库、将表视为可版本化的对象，通过SQL扩展暴露Git风格的操作（快照/标签、分支、差异比较，以及带显式冲突解决策略的合并）。Git4Data实现于云原生关系型数据库MatrixOne中，利用不可变对象存储和MVCC（多版本并发控制），使这些操作的成本与数据规模成比例。（注：原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Git4Data提出了一个数据库原生版本控制层，将数据库视为仓库、表视为可版本化对象，通过SQL扩展提供Git风格的快照、分支、差异和合并操作，以满足AI智能体并行探索数据时对隔离性、可复现性和可审计性的需求。
en_tdlr: Git4Data introduces a database-native version-control layer that treats databases as repositories and tables as versioned objects, exposing Git-style snapshot, branch, diff, and merge operations through SQL extensions to meet the isolation, reproducibility, and auditability needs of LLM agents exploring relational data in parallel.
